name: Chrome Hearts Leather Cross Patch Fleur Knee Pants
basis_of_authenticity: Dealer listing: sold as authentic by Justin Reed. No outside legit check; the basis is the dealer only.
model: Black leather, tonal cross patches, fleur knee, button fly, boot cut.
size: Dealer: "Tagged size 28SR but fits smaller"; listed as 25

Leather tab under the label: embossed, but the text is not legible in the photo (dealer states 28SR).
Lining: black fabric with tone-on-tone Chrome Hearts emblems.
